name: mcp-events
description: MCP Events (SEP-3415) for Codex: Codex can watch events on your MCP servers (poll, push or webhook), and an event wakes the idle session that asked for it.

interface.shortDescription: Watch events on your MCP servers; an event wakes the idle session
interface.longDescription: Adds the client side of the MCP Events extension (SEP-3415) to Codex. Ask Codex to watch something one of your MCP servers reports, such as a failed deploy or a new ticket; when it happens, the session is woken with a message naming the server, the event type and the event's id, and Codex reads the event and acts on it through its usual approvals.
defaultPrompt: What can you watch on my MCP servers?
Watch my deploys and tell me when one fails.
